blockers.detail: RQ6 requires s_9 through s_11 and FINAL: a=... b=... c=..., but PCS4v2 amendment 1 prompts for and parses STATE s0 through s8 plus FINAL_SUMMARY:. The mandated prompt/parser cannot represent the frozen RQ6 trace.
The fixed PCS4v2 compact prompt is referenced, but its state syntax, depth-8 example, and terminal marker conflict with RQ6's D=11, s_8 handoff, and FINAL line. No compatible exact prompt is frozen.
The 1,600-episode pool has no generation seed, generator namespace, or exact record-selection rule. The split seed 20261006 does not specify those values.

The split says 900 train / 200 val / test >=400 after gates, but source-decoding and test-mistake gates themselves require train/val/test membership. The exact test count and seeded assignment algorithm are not defined.
The source-mistake gate requires at least 15 A-wrong test episodes while splits are specified after gates; the gate cannot be evaluated until the test split exists.

The 75% A final-triple gate does not state whether malformed/unparsed episodes count as incorrect or whether accuracy is computed only over parseable traces; the source-episode helper reports both rates without selecting one.
6A-W lists end-s7, end-s8, and checkpoint, but checkpoint is also defined as immediately after the s8 newline, duplicating end-s8. The frozen capture needs three positions x nine layers.

6A-U requires capture after the s8: prefix before any value token, but no tokenizer-boundary mapping or exact checkpoint-location scoring rule is specified. Character offsets alone do not determine model token positions.
The partial-text handoff content is to be validated on val, but its candidate format, validation selection criterion, and tie rule are not frozen.

The source-decoding gate names a linear probe but does not specify solver, standardization, regularization candidates/selection, feature concatenation/order, or which validation score selects the probe.

The literal oracle-state arm is abbreviated with ellipses, the restart/partial arm insertion format is not fully specified, and the exact chat-template/tokenization and continuation parse policy are not pinned.
The M=2 retry changes D to 10 but does not specify whether to regenerate the pool, how to transform the frozen RQ6 prompt/checkpoints, or how its test split relates to the M=3 attempt.
The model families are named, but immutable model/tokenizer revisions and local artifact hashes are absent; this blocks a reproducible inference-only qualification run without downloads.

6B lacks an exact dataset revision/hash and test sample rule, A/B prompts, numeric answer canonicalization, sentence segmentation/token-count/tie rules for the 50% checkpoint, and matched-wrong prefix similarity/tie rules.
The later 6B bridge refers to about 3,000 GSM8K train problems, but the train selection and whether RQ6 qualification generates/scores train examples are not specified.
